tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo bzhugs so// swasti/ mkha' spyod ma dang chos skyong la stabs gcig tu gtor bsngo bya tshul ni/ mkha' spyod ma la zlum gtor dmar po'am/ dkar po gang rigs/ dur khrod bdag po la zlum gtor g.yas g.yon la dbal gshog pa'i rnam pa can du gtod pa'i rgyab gzhung chad yan la shur gsum smad zlum pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du lag g.yon gyi chang bu gyen bslang te/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor zlum gtor dkar po/ gtor rdzas sku bag can zhes pa sha chang la bshad kyang phyag len la bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye ma bsres pas 'thus par mdzad/ mar rgyan ji ltar rigs pa/ rgyab kyi g.yas ngos la sha skam rlon chung ngu re shing bu phra mo sogs la brten nas 'dzugs/ gtor gdugs byed na mkha' spyod ma la dmar po/ dur bdag la dkar po/ spyi gtor la ljang gu rnams mda' 'am ku sha'am gzhan ji ltar rigs pa la brten pa/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod nang mchod chu chang gi sbyong gsungs pa'i nang mchod ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang ngam bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i chang gang rung / gzhan gnyis go sla/ gu gul sogs spos dud kyi bdug mkha' spyod ma'i gtor 'bul tshar ba'i rjes su dur khrod bdag po'i gtor ma la lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan la/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ho lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e mched pas nam mkha' rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ suṃ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab/ de'i steng du thod pa skam po'i gzhal yas khang khrag gi chag chag btab cing glo snying rgyu ma'i drwa phyed 'phan dzar can/ zhing lpags kyi bla re bres pa'i dbus su paṃ padma maṇḍal/ ma surya maṇḍal/ a tsant+ra maṇḍal/ padma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang aṃ las dung dang 'gron bu hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba keng rus shin tu brjid pa'i gzugs can spyan bgrad cing zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/

phyag g.yas pas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams shing gsol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang / rin po che'i snyan cha 'khyil ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis la sha za ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya/ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu gsil ba'am rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis g.yab pa/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i don mdzad pa/ /dad ldan dam tshig chen po yang / /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sha ma shwa na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra e hya hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chu spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'khor skad cig gis dbang gi lha 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃḥbadzrilo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa re re'i dbu brgyan/ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya/ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dpal dur khrod kyi yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa dang tshe ring ba dang / thal mo brdab/

nad med pa dang / longs spyod 'phel ba dang / chom rkun mtha' dag bcing ba'i phrin las mdzod/ thal mo lan gnyis brdab/ oṃ gri ha rā dza gri ha rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this ma hā pi sha tsi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sidhi mmepra yatstshantu swāhā/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phyogs pa'i mthar se gol gtogs/ gsum sogs/ oṃ sha ma shwa na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ so so'i phyag rgya/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gandhe/ naiwi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'bul/ thal mo sbyor/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las las/ /ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /drag po'i gzugs su sku sprul pa/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /chos kyi bar chad nyer zhi nas/ /mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med du/ /'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ni/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa nas oṃ ā hūm̐ gi bar/ dkyil chog gi sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin la/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ padma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/

gzhi bdag la gtor ma 'bul na gzhan dang mthun/ mi 'bul na'ang chad pa'i skyon med/ 'di sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i sa skya pa'i rgyun gyi gtor chog nas zur du bkod pa lags// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
